items.title: Scarecrow with a Small Drum
items.alt: A wooden-faced scarecrow in a maroon knit cap and teal jacket sits cross-legged, tapping a small hand drum resting on one knee.
items.description: A wooden-faced scarecrow in a maroon knit cap and teal jacket sits cross-legged, tapping a small hand drum resting on one knee. An original scarecrow illustration for personal designs and classroom seasonal activities.

items.title: Scarecrow Hanging Harvest Bunting
items.alt: A deep-brown crochet-faced scarecrow in a lavender headwrap and mustard jumpsuit attaches blank fabric bunting between two short wooden posts.

items.title: Scarecrow and a Wind Spinner
items.alt: A playful pink-faced scarecrow in an orange knitted cap and plum work apron sits on a stump holding a small folded garden pinwheel.

items.title: Scarecrow Comparing Gourds
items.alt: A rush-faced scarecrow in an olive woven hat and teal fringed poncho holds a pear-shaped gourd between a round gourd and a long curved-neck gourd.

items.alt: A sleepy cloth-faced scarecrow in a weathered olive hat, brown jacket, cream waistcoat and striped trousers rests on a slatted wooden garden bench.
